notes.title: Patch 1.3
notes.content: This patch is to hopefully fix a bunch of minor achievement bugs we see people have been encounting!

notes.title: Patch 1.2!
notes.content:
Here are some more bug fixes!
- Updated some audio bugs
- Added title screen logo music
- Fixed bug preventing World 5 from unlocking (Just recomplete World 4's last level to unlock!)

notes.title: Patch 1.1 November 3rd!!!
notes.content:
Hi all!

We've heard your feedback and are pushing an update to address what we can!

- Fixed Hover Rectangle visual bugs
- Optimized fade block hover performance
- Change Level Select Icon
- Fix scroll Bug
- Fix main menu Bug
- Fixed the 3 second achievement bug 
- Add better start tutorial
- Remove circle block button
